title: Luv Letter
keyLabel: D♭ 大调 / B♭ 小调（5 降号）
description: DJ OKAWARI 的经典钢琴与弦乐作品。轻盈的钢琴旋律叠加温暖的节拍，飘逸而深情——Syrinx 首首正式接入曲目。全曲采用 Lumière 钢琴母谱合成伴奏，速度变化与谱面标记一致，与长笛谱逐小节精确同步。
descriptionEn: A modern classic of piano and strings. The lilting piano melody rides warm, gentle beats — airy and heartfelt. Accompaniment is rendered from the original piano score, with every tempo change matching the sheet music and bar-accurate sync with the flute part.
